vertical14.scope: Basic movement only; no global physics or AI changes. Fast descent and separate left/right return circuits.

groups.purpose: A rising-road guard, paired courtyard front and cart pockets screen the doorway, while one descending-exit guard can be flanked from the rescue alcove.
Open eave flank supports the same upper courtyard, with separate aim angles rather than vertically stacked bodies.
A two-tool doorway front, separated cart pair, far lip guard and raised awning pair expose distinct area/precision choices.
Nearby below-market ramp guards can be hit from the market west lip or approached via a short left drop, without visiting the remote D turn.
Last shoulder above the family yard cross-covers both the left return and fast descent. The outer east road offers a rear angle rather than mandatory cleanup.
House-front pair and cart side screen occupy the right yard; precise resident spirit fire remains on the left alcove.
Four unequal aerial approach positions pressure the bridge and its final approach, not an unrelated upper floor.
Eastern approach guards threaten the refuge from outside its body and leave the defense centre open.
